name: write_file
description: Creates a new file or fully overwrites an existing one with the given content. HARD LIMIT: 'content' cannot exceed 16000 characters per call — beyond that the call is rejected with an error. For longer files, split across multiple calls: the first without 'append' (or with append:false), the following ones with 'append': true, until the file is complete.

path.description: The relative or absolute path of the file to create/overwrite/append to.

content.description: The content to write. Without 'append' (or with append:false) it replaces the entire file. MAXIMUM 16000 characters per call: if the total content is longer, split it across multiple calls with 'append'.

append.description: If true, appends 'content' to the end of the file instead of overwriting it (creates the file if it doesn't exist yet, same as the first call). Use it for chunks AFTER the first one when building a long file piece by piece.
